about: Reusable Higgsfield creative recipes for The Guided Planet. A recipe paints an ENVIRONMENT or a PROP. It never paints a character, a logo, a screen or a word: Bloop and the Planet Friends are composited on top from the approved library (publishing/library/characters.json), so their identity can never drift. Every recipe ships a vector default in publishing/templates/art.ts, so a failed or rejected generation never holds a page back.

house.style: Flat editorial illustration for a premium independent children's newspaper. Clean confident ink linework with round caps, flat colour fills, generous negative space, gentle grain. Warm, optimistic, calm. In the spirit of a hand made illustrated map, not a cartoon, not 3D, not glossy.
house.palette: Cream #F9F8F6, deep ink navy #1A1A2E, butter gold #EDC35F, deep gold #C99A28, espresso #2E2818, grey blue #8A8FA3, pale sage #E8F0EE and mid sage #C9DBD2. One gold accent only.
house.never: No people, no children, no faces, no characters or mascots, no animals with faces, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no screens showing an interface, no brand names, no photographic realism, no purple gradients, no neon.
house.references: Composition only: brand/references/2026-10-05-social-reference-board.webp. Never a character reference.

draft.creditsNote: About one credit per still at low quality, from the mood stills run of 13 September 2026 (shared/schools-curriculum.ts). Confirm against the ledger after the first run.

final.creditsNote: Not yet measured. The first final run records what Higgsfield reports, and the budget gate uses that from then on.

video.creditsNote: Not yet measured. silent-ugc budgets about one pound a video; treat as unknown until the ledger has a real figure.

newspaper-cover.use: Page 1 backdrop behind the masthead, the headline and the approved Bloop cutout.
newspaper-cover.composition: A night sky over the curved horizon of a small round green planet. The International Space Station as a small clean silhouette crossing the upper left third. A soft glow behind it. A grassy hill rising on the lower right where a character will be placed later, left EMPTY. The top 30 percent is quiet sky for the headline.
newspaper-cover.lighting: Night, soft butter glow from the station, faint rim light on the planet's edge.
newspaper-cover.characterPlacement: None in the image. Leave the lower right hill clear: Bloop is placed there by the layout engine.
newspaper-cover.output: PNG, no text, no border, edges painted to bleed.

world-map.use: Page 2, the map of the Guided Planet.
world-map.composition: A small round planet floating in space, seen slightly from above, with six landmark places on its surface: an observatory dome, a district of workshops with a gear, a forest, a garden of flowers, a reading room with books, and a compass rose campsite. A dotted gold path joins them. Labels are added by the layout, so no words.
world-map.lighting: Soft daylight on the planet against a deep ink sky.

discovery-observatory.composition: Space, the curve of the Earth, an orbiting station or telescope, star field. Room on one side for type.
discovery-observatory.lighting: Night with a single warm accent.

maker-district.composition: A friendly street of small workshops and studios, sawtooth roofs, lit windows, a big gear, a lightbulb sign with no letters, workbenches with simple tools.

thinking-forest.use: AI, algorithms, misinformation and critical thinking.
thinking-forest.composition: A calm forest clearing with tall simple trees, paths that fork, signposts with no words, a few glowing question shaped leaves.
thinking-forest.characterPlacement: None. Leave space on the right for Bloop.

connection-garden.composition: Two small homes on two green hills far apart, joined across a valley by a gentle dotted gold line and a row of flowers. Warm and quiet.

research-room.use: The Research Room: what the evidence actually says.
research-room.composition: A tidy reading room with tall shelves, an oversized magnifying glass on a desk, charts pinned up as abstract shapes with no numbers.

family-explorer.composition: A dotted gold trail winding across hills under a starry espresso sky, with five little stopping places: a tent, a bench, a telescope, a picnic blanket, a doorstep.

bloop-explains.use: Bloop explaining how technology works. The BACKDROP only.
bloop-explains.composition: A simple workbench scene with an open machine showing friendly gears and wires, everything rounded, space on the left for a character to stand.
bloop-explains.characterPlacement: None in the image. The approved Bloop cutout is placed on the left by the layout.

printable-activity.use: Black and white line art for colouring and cutting out.
printable-activity.composition: One clear object (a rocket, a postcard border, a gadget) in clean black outlines on white, thick even lines, no shading, large areas to colour.
printable-activity.output: PNG, pure black on white, no grey, no text.

digital-passport.composition: A round rubber stamp style emblem with a single simple icon (a planet, a rocket, a gear, a flower, a compass), no words, gold ink on burgundy.
digital-passport.output: PNG with transparent background, no text.

cover-reveal.default: Made in code at zero credits (publishing/distribution/motion.ts): the rendered cover itself, animated. A Higgsfield version is an option only, started from the approved cover backdrop, never from a frame containing Bloop.

trailer-30s.concept: Bloop looks up at the International Space Station as The Guided Planet unfolds to reveal its five stories, one beat each, ending on the cover and the free download line.

bloop-explainer.concept: Bloop explains who chose the next video, using the recommendation machine diagram from page 8. Bloop is the approved cutout animated in code, not a generated character.
